name: vintest-adapter
description: Discovers and runs VinTest game tests via the VS Code Testing panel

vintest.projects.markdownDescription: Explicit list of VinTest projects to use. When empty, all Cake projects in the workspace are auto-detected. Each entry must specify `cakeBuildProject`; `dataPath` is optional and defaults to `gamedata/` next to the Cake project.

cakeBuildProject.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the Cake .csproj (e.g. 'MyMod/ZZCakeBuild/CakeBuild.csproj').

cake.dataPath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the VintageStory data directory (Saves/, Logs/, TestResults/). Defaults to 'gamedata/' next to the Cake project.

cake.target.description: Cake target to invoke for this project. Overrides the global vintest.cakeTarget when set.

vintest.cake.vsPath.description: Absolute path to the VintageStory installation directory to be passed to --vs-path Cake argument. Falls back to the VINTAGE_STORY environment variable, then to a <VINTAGE_STORY> property in any Directory.Build.props found in the workspace.

vintest.cake.configuration.description: Dotnet build configuration. Mirrors the --configuration Cake argument. IGNORED when debugging tests.

vintest.cake.ignoreLogErrors.description: When true, captured log lines matching error patterns do *NOT* fail the build. Mirrors the --ignore-log-errors Cake argument.

vintest.waitForOtherTests.markdownDescription:
Milliseconds to wait after a run is requested before starting a cake task.

If your projects have regular unit tests and you use [C# Dev Kit](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-dotnettools.csdevkit) or [DotRush](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=nromanov.dotrush) to run them from VS Code, this ensures that VinTest would spawn its `dotnet run` after the other extension has spawned its `dotnet build`, avoiding conflicts over same build files.

This option is disabled (set to 0) by default.
